title: Isandro and the Terminal
author: Xanthe Almeida
blurb: Xanthe Okonkwo, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
